end.summary:
Practised ways to keep school clean, green, and safe.
Named using dustbins, emptying full bins, sweeping, and picking up personal litter.
Explained sorting wet waste into the green bin and keeping plastic and foil out of compost.
Explained that keeping the school clean is everyone’s shared job; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised answering with examples and reasons, including sorting wet waste, using bins, and picking up personal litter. They explained that plastic wrappers and foil do not go into compost and that everyone should help so cleaning staff are not working alone. At home, ask Anika to give three everyday school-cleaning actions and explain why each one helps.
